rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice for something exceptionally impressive or good.

example.english: The pineapple buns at this cha chaan teng are phenomenal—crispy on the outside and soft inside.
example.traditional: 呢間茶記啲菠蘿包真係勁，外脆內軟。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 di1 bo1 lo4 baau1 zan1 hai6 ging6 ngoi6 ceoi3 noi6 jyun5

rows.note: Choose this when the phenomenal quality is the striking scale or impact of a result, effort, or achievement.

example.english: They finished building the bridge in three days; the speed was phenomenal.
example.traditional: 佢哋用咗三日就起好座橋，速度真係驚人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 zo2 saam1 jat6 zau6 hei2 hou2 zo6 kiu4 cuk1 dou6 zan1 hai6 ging1 jan4

rows.note: Use this for an explicitly extraordinary or outstanding quality, especially in more careful or written language.

example.english: She completed this research with phenomenal perseverance.
example.traditional: 佢以非凡嘅毅力完成咗呢項研究。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ji5 fei1 faan4 ge3 ngai6 lik6 jyun4 sing4 zo2 nei1 hong6 jin4 gau3
